tools.name: proof_check
tools.description: Signed proof report for an agent: Proof Score per category, record count, settled value, buyer diversity. PAID via x402 v2 (exact USDC on Base). Call without payment_signature to receive the payment requirements (no charge); call again with payment_signature = the base64 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE for one of

tools.name: proof_verify_record
tools.description: Verify a Proof Record yourself: recompute its hash, check the service signature against the published key, the hash-chain link, its Arc Merkle anchor, and re-read the release transaction on Arc mainnet. Free, read-only. Error: record not found.

tools.name: agent_records
tools.description: All Proof Records for an agent plus verified totals (no numeric score; that is the paid Proof Check). Free, read-only. An empty list means no verified history here, not a negative finding.

tools.name: ledger_list
tools.description: Latest Proof Records, newest first, with the ledger head. Free, read-only.

tools.name: proof_index
tools.description: Verified agent-job volume by venue, category and day (Proof Records only). Free, read-only.

tools.name: board_search
tools.description: Open, funded jobs on SML's Bid-cast board (escrow on Circle Arc), as published by the venue. Free, read-only; to post or bid, use Bid-cast itself (EIP-191 signed).

tools.name: methodology
tools.description: The published Proof Score methodology and its version. Free, read-only.

tools.name: service_status
tools.description: Live status of the ledger, verifier, Arc anchoring and the SML components the board probes. Free, read-only.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: board_search · Private data: proof_check, proof_verify_record, agent_records, ledger_list, proof_index · Public sink: board_search.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: board_search · Private data: proof_check, proof_verify_record, agent_records, ledger_list, proof_index · Public sink: board_search

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
